positions.title: Staff AI Engineer
positions.description:
Joined Breezy as one of the first engineers during the early stages when we had just a handful of customers. Now we're experiencing explosive growth and it's been an incredible journey building the technical foundation for a company that's transforming how HVAC contractors run their businesses.
As one of two full-time engineers (alongside the founding engineer), I've worn many hats - from architecting our AI Voice Agent to modernizing our entire infrastructure.

Some highlights from my time at Breezy:

- Built an AI Voice Agent using Vapi, OpenAI GPT-4o, and Twilio that's now deployed across our customer base including several of our largest customers. The voice agent has handled thousands of phone calls, saving our customers thousands in payroll expenses and becoming one of our key selling points during demos.
- Shipped dozens of revenue-driving features including: AI CSR, Reporting, Integrated SMS (Twilio), Online Booking, Automated Review Management, AI-Generated Service History (GPT-4o), Map-based Maintenance Opportunity Finder (PostGIS), Integrated Lending and Prequalification (Wisetack), Card on File (Tilled), Bulk Pricebook Management & Pricebook Photos (Flatfile, Lambda), Invoices, and more
- Led our infrastructure modernization from manual EC2 deployments to Kubernetes (EKS) with GitOps (FluxCD), championed web client data rearchitecture to Hasura (cut feature dev time in half), and established Cypress E2E testing across core modules to uplevel quality and allow our eng team to ship quickly with confidence.
- Architected our data-ingestion pipeline to support customer data migrations using Hatchet, EKS, and microservices — critical infrastructure to onboard upmarket customers.
- Pioneered AI-assisted development workflows using Claude Code, Neon, and Docker that have significantly boosted our small team's productivity.

positions.title: Co-Founder, CTO
positions.description:
Joined Spore (now Truffle) as the first engineering hire and quickly grew into the role of CTO and cofounder.

Majority of my time was spent developing the product and working with our engineering team to ship quickly and iterate on user feedback.

Some highlights from my time at Truffle:
- Led development of the Truffle.TV browser extension and scaled it up to 400k MAUs. The product replicated the majority of Twitch's feature set for YouTube livestreaming and we also built out novel features like the Battle Pass which gamified the social experience for livestreamer communities. December 2022, we supported one of the largest livestreams on YouTube live (peaked at 315k concurrent YT viewers, w/ a peak of 30k+ concurrent Truffle users).
- Led development and the launch of the Truffle Mobile application on iOS and Android. Built a bespoke chat client for YT Live we embedded inside the Truffle mobile app.
- We brought Ludwig Ahgren (set the record on Twitch for most subscriptions) on as a cofounder, which completely changed the trajectory of the company.
- Worked with a ton of large creators and their teams: Ludwig, TimTheTatman, JaidenAnimations, DrLupo, Fuslie, Valkyrae, Sykkuno, Myth, Lily Pichu, Iron Mouse, ShyLily, PointCrow, Jidion, Ottomated, and more.
- Built dozens of custom merch storefronts on top of the Truffle developer platform (used Shopify for order management, Truffle for the storefront and user management) which did over $1M in merch revenue.
- Created a recruiting pipeline to bring on high-potential engineering talent from Colorado universities (Colorado School of Mines, CU Boulder). We sourced devs through this program who interned at Amazon, Google, Meta, Tesla, and Microsoft.
- We raised $3.25M in venture funding from VCs and angels.
- Worked with the eng team to build our own developer platform to support the development of 3rd-party widgets through the Truffle.TV extension that integrated with creators' livestreams.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Redis · TypeScript · Deno · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Chrome Extensions · Scylla · GraphQL · Elasticsearch · React Native · React.js · Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Started an AI-powered parking company while I was in school to provide real-time spot counts and analytics for parking lots and garages.

Over the course of three years we learned and built a ton and it was our first-real taste of building a company. The company didn't get very far and we spent too much time on engineering instead of bringing a product to market. We raised money through a couple of grants and ran a pilot with students and faculty at Colorado School of Mines. My role included a bit of everything ranging from engineering, business development, recruiting cofounders, and developing partnerships with the university.

The product was very technically difficult to build. After many iterations we finished with a product that was able to track cars with 95% accuracy by running CV models on the edge with a raspberry-pi, infrared camera, and Google Coral's Edge TPU ML Accelerator. There were a host of challenges that we had to work through around running ML on the edge, power, networking, object tracking in dim/no light, over the air deployments while also building out a platform with multiple client applications on web and mobile.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React Native · React.js · MongoDB · Python (Programming Language) · Raspberry Pi · Google Coral · AWS CloudFormation

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Interned as a Software Development Engineer over the summers and during the school year while I finished up school. Upon graduation I joined Workday full-time as a developer working in the Productivity Technology org.

Some of the highlights during my time at Workday:
- Upon joining full-time I was placed on a small-team spinning up a new product for designing email templates. At the time, we were the fastest team in Workday to launch a product to GA (9 months) for Workday's 32 million users. I worked as a full-stack engineer and led a multitude of different engineering efforts for the team as well as other cross-org initiatives across product, infrastructure, and instrumentation. Technologies: React, Typescript, Redux, Jest, Cypress, Java, Jenkins, Splunk, and more.
- Helped rewrite the Workdrive (Google Drive for Workday) client application in React, Typescript, Redux, Lerna, Jenkins, Jest, Cypress, Selenium, and other client-side technologies.
- During my first summer as an intern I worked with a team of other interns to create a formula editor for the Worksheets product (Google Sheets for Workday) using React, Typescript, Emotion, Cypress, and Selenium.
- Was the Workday Campus Ambassador at my university and worked closely with University Recruiting.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Redux · React.js · Jenkins · Cypress.io · Java · MySQL

positions.title: Adjunct Professor - CSCI306: Software Engineering
positions.description:
During the Fall of 2020 I taught a section of Software Engineering as an Adjunct Professor at Colorado School of Mines.

Gave lectures covering a broad range of Software Engineering topics ranging from git, design patterns, test-driven development, OOP, and more.

Create a new course module for building a webserver with the Java Spring Boot framework.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor - Data Structures
positions.description: During the summer of 2020 I taught an online section of Data Structures in C++ for Colorado School of Mines.

positions.title: Machine Learning Research Assistant
positions.description: During my thesis I worked with Dr. Chuan Yue's research group working on crowd sourcing and microtasks. My work was geared towards using Machine Learning to extract insights from a corpus of crowd-sourcing tasks using topic modeling and other data science techniques in Python.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor - CSCI 102 Introduction to Python
positions.description: My first teaching gig at Mines. Oversaw the lab-based section to CS101 at Mines and gave introductory programming lectures in Python and also created new course materials and labs.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant, MURF Fellow
positions.description: During the 2017-2018 school-year I worked as a Research Assistant to Dr. Chuan Yue under the MURF Fellowship and worked on an info-sec project to analyze attack vectors for a university CTF competition. Used Splunk to extract insights from the competition data-set and generate visuals as part of a larger research paper.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: My first experience working on a startup. Built a product to guide career conversations between managers and direct reports by letting users plot their skills on a grid with axis of what they like to do and what they're good at. Scaled the product from a client-side proof of concept to a full-stack web application built with jQuery, Bootstrap, Node.js, MongoDB, and AWS.
